fault_plan.derived_from: Actual observed original-provider cutpoints, frozen before candidate execution; not guessed port counts.
fault_plan.observation_endpoint: Deep-freeze the complete semantic record at the declared consumer boundary. Later GC is a separate explicit record, never retroactively mutates earlier observations.
fault_plan.occurrence: One fault before/after each declared primitive/call/return boundary where meaningful, first-error order and exact injected-object identity retained.
fault_plan.traceback_policy: Save full raw traceback separately from semantic observations; do not normalize exception fields, object lifetimes, GC counts or original runtime differences.

normal_route_domains.description: All four combinations of the two independent _slot_ledger is-not-None observations, including dynamic attribute changes between predicate and method lookup.
All eight combinations of the three independent ledger choices, with literal call lookup occurring again after each predicate.
The three left-to-right receipt-binding comparisons: first true short-circuits later getters; false/false/false continues; comparison and truth may each raise or return opaque values.
Candidate/baseline signatures comparison and truth; reject may raise or return, and a returned rejection must continue exactly as the original does.

object_protocol_domains: Instance overrides, subclass overrides, custom __getattribute__, descriptors, bound and detached callables for every original dynamic service/Store/Ledger method expression.
Temporary Ledger and Store receiver death at original LOAD_METHOD/call boundaries; retain only observer weakrefs/tokens, no accidental strong receiver retention.
Global uint64/digest/reject lookups and the original bound builtins fallback, missing names, runtime replacement between calls and original first error/cause/context.
Exact2-value rollback/get_json and3-value native result unpack: short/long sizes, iterator replacement/next exceptions, StopIteration identity and destruction of the returned container.
Discarded validation/Store.get/build-receipt results must be released at the original POP_TOP before the next provider or ACK.
Dictionary literal key/value evaluation, repeated args/snapshot reads, shared alias identity, opaque numeric/object types and arbitrary-size values remain unchanged.
Two adoption _native calls remain distinct sites; all ignored locals _, _data/_program/_baseline_data/_baseline_program remain live until the original frame releases them.
Cold and declared warm callsite history preserve unnormalized AttributeError name/obj and original runtime-specific metadata.
Normal return, nested outer except, unhandled provider error, held/released traceback and explicit consumer GC phases preserve locals ordering on each actual runtime separately.
oracle_rule: Execute only the exact frozen original methods with independent fake providers before evaluating any candidate. Expected outputs must not be derived from the HIA ports or generated graph.
pending: Original-only fake observations not yet executed or accepted.
No HIA generation/compilation/VM/Native/SQLite test has run.
New Source/Native test module, installed controls and complete caller qualifier will be designed after independent original observations; no absence presented as PASS.
resource_controls_separate_from_original: Canonical selected child NativeBuildAdmission, Store artifact/profile and transaction images from the same attempt; plain fake provider behavior cannot prove resource custody.
Actual child native loss before/after entry, unconfirmed foreign ACK, ordinary confirmed provider failure, parent ACK loss after confirmed child and no unsafe retry.
Real Slot SQL operation before/after its native calls requires the independent Slot owner causal mechanism; no shared loss field injection and no inference solely from exception class.

Public service.call original atomic transaction: business receipt and request terminal update share the canonical Store connection, commit/rollback and original request/cost behavior; dynamic Store replacement remains the original domain.
Direct private handler calls add no transaction; no hidden BEGIN/COMMIT is inserted by the new dispatcher.
Healthy ACK release versus unknown resource retention, nested strong ancestors and read weak-policy compatibility, normal/held traceback finalization.
Full installed worker and exact replay with source identity drift, all original deadlines and original caller bodies retained.
